_comment: Generated by tools/data_gen/build_vanity_stalls.py. The `rebut` choice is gated on a flag set by an EARLIER chapter, so answering the fair requires having learned something on the way to it.

start.speaker: The Comfort-Seller
start.text: Look at your feet. You have earned a soft road. This will make the rest of the way feel like the part you have already done.
start.text_zh: 看看你的脚。你配得一条软路。买了它，剩下的路就会像你已经走完的那样轻省。

text_variants.text: Look at your feet. You have earned a soft road. This will make the rest of the way feel like the part you have already done.
text_variants.text_zh: 您这样的人，何必与自己过不去？剩下的路，可以由它替您走。

text_variants.text: Look at your feet. You have earned a soft road. This will make the rest of the way feel like the part you have already done.
text_variants.text_zh: 你的眼太清了，不好做生意。不过——看看你的脚。你配得一条软路。买了它，剩下的路就会像你已经走完的那样轻省。

choices.text: I have already been offered the soft road. It went downhill the whole way.
choices.text_zh: 这条软路我遇见过。它一路都在往下走。

choices.text: Buy it. Surely one small indulgence won't cost me much.
choices.text_zh: 买下吧。区区一点放纵，想必花不了我多少。

choices.text: No. My peace is not for sale at this fair.
choices.text_zh: 不。我的平安不在这集市上出售。

answered.speaker: The Comfort-Seller
answered.text_zh: 贩子耸耸肩：「爬过山的人最难做生意。」

bought.speaker: The Comfort-Seller
bought.text: A wise purchase! Wear it well... it suits the crowd, if not the road.
bought.text_zh: 明智之选！好好戴着……它配得上人群，纵然配不上这条路。

refused.speaker: The Comfort-Seller
refused.text: Suit yourself. The narrow-eyed never could enjoy a good fair.
refused.text_zh: 随你便。眯着眼的人，从来就享受不了一场好集市。
